# Proportionate verification and truthful completion

- Run tests that exercise changed behavior and relevant project checks from package.json. Do not add trivial implementation-mirroring tests or repeatedly run unchanged suites.
- Prioritise ownership denial, atomic writes/numbering, money rounding, edit conflicts, immutable invoices, partial-payment reversals, idempotent sends/jobs and revoked links.
- For UI changes, inspect desktop/mobile rendering, keyboard behavior and reduced motion. For PDFs, inspect rendered documents.
- Use synthetic fixtures. Do not email clients, import private invoice folders or run destructive live-data tests.
- Distinguish unit/mock, local integration, provider integration and production verification. State exactly what was and was not exercised.
- Keep acceptance criteria tied to working UI/API/data behavior. A scaffold, stub, TODO, installed library or passing build alone is not feature completion.
